name: Hatsushiba Takane
source:
A "carnivorous" and powerful sort of girl, very tall and hot-blooded. Although she loves to tease, she can be very caring as well.

She loves cute guys like Aoi and often hugs him from behind to surprise him. Can often be found on the roof of the school, tanning in a bikini.
